about: Quest data that uses the engine features of 2026-11-11 (whisper choice, own spawn only).

entries.why: Secret Orders step 14: the Arawn Commander's riddle. The journal says to answer [knowledge] or [power], but the step was an Interact and ended on a right-click (verifier P05-B3). It is now a custom whisper step (StepType 8, completed by the engine)
entries.source: Allakhazam quest 351: the Arawn Commander asks KNOWLEDGE or POWER (no period data on a lesser reward for one answer, so both answers go on)

entries.why: the riddle takes either word, whispered or clicked (new engine step kind 'whisper')
